follow-up time: Through delivery and the clinical postpartum period
cohort: 13 pregnant women with positive SARS-CoV-2 polymerase chain reaction admitted for delivery between March 1st and June 30th, 2020
finding: Vertical transmission of COVID-19 during childbirth was not observed, and while clinical practices at the beginning of the pandemic were not always evidence-based, they adapted to international recommendations over time.
mod_finding: 15.4% of births to mothers with COVID-19 ended in cesarean section.
